🎥🎬: Creature Commandos (2024–Present)

Amanda Waller assembles a team of dangerous and unusual prisoners—known as the Creature Commandos—to carry out missions too deadly for ordinary agents. Led by Rick Flag Sr., the team includes monsters and metahumans who barely trust one another but are forced to work together.

Their mission takes them to Pokolistan, where they are ordered to protect Princess Ilana Rostovic. But as the Commandos investigate a supernatural threat surrounding the princess, they uncover a conspiracy that puts the entire country in danger. Along the way, their violent pasts, personal conflicts, and strange abilities make keeping the team together almost as difficult as completing the mission.
